newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shr index falls 1.79 pct, ends at 21-mth low.
newsitem.headline: Manila shr index falls 1.79 pct, ends at 21-mth low.

text.p: Philippine stocks closed sharply lower on Friday buckling under the pressure of a weaker peso, traders said.
The main index closed 44.56 points lower, or 1.79 percent, at a 21-month closing low of 2,448.93. The market barometer also set a new year-low at its intra-day low of 2,447.38.
"The peso was weaker and it made a lot of investors panicky especially after trading was halted this morning," said Henry Ong, trader at Sapphire Securities.
